declared: 7 November 2026, after sealed sets f and g were spent (r44 adopted) and before any further climate development
purpose: The next unseen milestone check under policy v3, for one future finalist (e.g. P8 maritime lag).
boxes: eight climates the 78 known definitions do not cover: monsoon savanna (Top End), equatorial highland (New Guinea), equatorial lowland rainforest (Congo basin), West African forest-savanna edge (Ivory Coast), southern tropical plateau (Zambia), Brazilian cerrado, subarctic interior (Alaska), arctic tundra (Taimyr)
rules: Never use for tuning, mechanism choice or candidate selection. Run once, paired with the then-adopted reference, for a single finalist that has passed the development (S49) and 28 km stages; retain all outcomes. Opened only with the owner's release.
scope: Separated scored-box metadata with a 56 km margin on every box (separation_audit.json, audited against every calibration/**/regions*.json and rotclimate.earth.REGIONS). Names carry an h_ prefix so no cached Earth case collides. Global input/forcing references and halos may be shared: not wholly independent forcing.
